decision: Rejected all candidate INT8 output recurrence/prefill fusion layouts; restore production sources and artifacts unchanged.
precision: INT8 FFN and output weights; BF16 activations/MAC and FP32 recurrent state

protocol.order: A/B/B/A for 31 workers; one two-trial screening process for 24 workers

candidate_31_workers.design: Seven prepare/update/finish lanes, two copy bridges, eight W8A16 projection workers; same five-BO layout as accepted BF16 fusion. Decode each tile once for two tokens, apply row scale after all K tiles. Projection stack 17408 bytes.
candidate_31_workers.stage_validation: Bitwise FP32 state, projection/residual, untouched auxiliary vectors, FP64 projection, reset/replay, immutable inputs and guards passed.
candidate_31_workers.assessment: Only about 0.16% whole-model gain, insufficient evidence to retain the added production complexity. Isolated hot-stage timing overstates the end-to-end benefit.

candidate_24_workers.design: Combine state update and finish on each of seven lanes. Split state/y output retains original FP32 operation order and fits local memory.
candidate_24_workers.stage_validation: Same bitwise, FP64, reset and guard checks passed.
candidate_24_workers.assessment: Screening whole-model run is about 3.5% slower; rejected without broader model regression or extended timing.

candidate_32_workers.design: Eleven prepare/update-finish lanes (ten with three heads, one with two), two copy bridges and eight projection workers. Group state drains to avoid exceeding shim output count.
compilation: Initial ten-way input split rejected: no MemTile has 1 input / 10 output DMA channels.
Split input and state drain groups into five/five/one lanes, with five/six-way finish joins: no legal routing found.
Explicit placement of projection workers on row 5 and recurrence/copy workers on rows 2–4 also failed routing.
candidate_32_workers.validation: No hardware dispatch; unsupported layouts, not passing kernels.
candidate_32_workers.assessment: Compiler routing failures constrain these layouts, not proof that all possible layouts are impossible or whole-model hardware limits have been reached.

limitations: No native INT8 MAC claim; arithmetic uses BF16 after local weight expansion.
Host wall time does not identify device compute utilization, actual DDR bandwidth or program-switch cost.
The 24-worker screening run is not an A/B/B/A acceptance measurement.
BF16 fusion accepted in 9ebf8a2 is retained; INT8 output remains separate.
next_action: Investigate resident decode recurrence/output fusion, beginning with BF16, while retaining exact state/output tests and whole-model timing gates.
restoration_checks: Release/test builds and 3/3 CTest passed after restoring all production code to 9ebf8a2; both BF16 and INT8 FFN+output CLI dispatches succeeded.

restored_initial_token_profile.scope: One instrumented initial token per precision, zero initial state, default sequential path. Host stage wall time includes program switches, DMA and compute. Exploratory evidence, not a steady-state benchmark.
